items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: And I did that until the very fine president of the Gas Light Band would hire me on Sundays. He was working at Alfred's. That's when I started with Joe Kelly.

ctx.x: And I did a lot of gigging, with Art Hodes, Bill Tinkley. And I did that until the very fine president of the Gas Light Band would hire me on Sundays. He was working at Alfred's. That's when I started with Joe Kelly.
